description: Every call the brand had, newest first, across its own Twilio or Telnyx numbers AND its WhatsApp numbers: channel all (default), phone or whatsapp. Each call: channel, from, to, direction, status, duration, price, plus what Hermoso knows of a phone call (forwarded to, missed, texted back, recording, tracked campaign). number, direction (inbound or outbound), status, search, since, before and limit filter. callId returns one call in full with its recordings (WhatsApp keeps none). WhatsApp calls are the last 48 hours Hermoso received. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: list_calls
title: List calls
